out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at FRONT (BEVERAGE AREA) handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. PIC ADDED SOAP DURING THE INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS THIS SINK NEEDS TO BE DESIGNATED FOR HANDWASHING, AND HANDWASHING ONLY. PLEASE ENSURE ALL STAFF UNDERSTANDS HANDWASHING SINKS SHOULD BE USED FOR HANDWASHING ONLY.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at FRONT (BEVERAGE AREA) handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC ADDED PAPER TOWELS DURING THE INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS THIS SINK NEEDS TO BE DESIGNATED FOR HANDWASHING, AND HANDWASHING ONLY. PLEASE ENSURE ALL STAFF UNDERSTANDS HANDWASHING SINKS SHOULD BE USED FOR HANDWASHING ONLY. SUPER PHO (Inspection Date: 09/22/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at FRONT handwashing sink used by food employees.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. EHS WILL SEND PIC A COPY OF SIGNAGE THAT MAY BE POSTED. PLEASE ENSURE SIGNAGE IS POSTED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours: OBSERVED A POT (WITH LID) OF BEEF/CHICKEN BROTH IN THE WALK-IN COOLER MADE THE DAY PRIOR TO INSPECTION AT 47F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. PIC DISCARDED THE BROTH DURING INSPECTION. PIC PROVIDED GUIDANCE ON PROPER COOLING METHODS. PLEASE ENSURE COOLING FOODS ARE NOT KEPT IN LARGE POTS WITH LIDS UNTIL THEY MEET 41F OR BELOW.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Restriction & Storage; Medicines Location
violations.observation: OBSERVED A BOTTLE OF ARTIFICIAL TEARS IN THE LEFT TWO-DOOR PREP-TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Employees' medicines shall be properly stored to prevent contamination of food and food contact surfaces. PIC REMOVED ARTIFICIAL TEARS FROM THE COOLER AND UNDERSTANDS EMPLOYEE MEDICINES NEED TO BE SEGREGATED AND SHOULD NOT BE STORED IN REFRIGERATORS.

violations.title: Restricted Use Pesticide, Conditions of use
violations.observation: Restricted, commercial use pesticides present in the facility are applied by the operator who is not a certified pesticide applicator. OBSERVED RESIDENTIAL PEST CONTROL IN THE ESTABLISHMENT.
violations.corrective_action: Because of their toxicity, restricted use pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. PIC REMOVED PEST CONTROL FROM THE ESTABLISHMENT DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS RESIDENTIAL PEST CONTROL MAY NOT BE USED IN THE ESTABLISHMENT. PLEASE PROVIDE THE EHS WITH A COMMERCIAL PEST CONTROL INVOICE BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: RIGHT TWO-DOOR PREP-TOP AND WALK-IN COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. PIC PURCHASED UNIT THERMOMETERS. PLEASE ADD UNIT THERMOMETERS AS SOON AS POSSIBLE TO THESE UNITS.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. OBSERVED ONE SMALL ALIVE COCKROACH ON THE HANDWASHING SINK NEAR THE ICE MACHINE AND ONE DEAD COCKROACH ON CAULK AT THREE-VAT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. PLEASE ENSURE A LICENSED COMMERCIAL PEST CONTROL COMPANY SERVICES THE ESTABLISHMENT BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Corrosion-Resistant/Nonabsorbent Materials
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following storage containers are not durable: OBSERVED GROCERY BAGS AND A NON-NSF APPROVED STORAGE BIN USED TO DIRECTLY STORE VARIOUS FOOD ITEMS.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be durable, corrosion-resistant, and nonabsorbent. PIC UNDERSTANDS THESE CONTAINERS/BAGS SHOULD NOT BE USED AS THEY ARE NOT DURABLE/NSF-APPROVED AND ARE NOT FOOD GRADE. PLEASE GRADUALLY REPLACE THESE BAGS/CONTAINERS WITH NSF APPROVED/FOOD GRADE CONTAINERS.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED AN ODOR COMING FROM THE GREASE TRAP NEAR THE DISHWASHING MACHINE.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. PLEASE ENSURE THE GREASE TRAP IS CLEANED ON A PER NEED BASIS.
